title: Electricity Sector Law, 5756-1996
source_id: Sefer HaChukim 5756 (ס״ח תשנ״ו), p 208; Wikisource page: חוק משק החשמל
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק משק החשמל; heading prints חוק משק החשמל, התשנ״ו–1996. Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשנ״ו, 208|חוק משק החשמל|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/13/law/13_lsr_211303.pdf}}. Commencement: most provisions from 13 Adar 5756 (4 March 1996), the penal provisions from the date of publication. Confirmed on the page that the billing machinery is in this Law and not elsewhere: s 30 (תפקידי הרשות, functions of the Electricity Authority, tariff-setting first among them), s 31 (קביעת תעריפים), s 31א (תשלומים מופחתים, reduced payments), s 32 (עדכון התעריפים), and s 17(c) obliging an essential-service licensee to collect payments in accordance with Authority tariffs. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ה, 688 (Amendment No 20), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_7458915.pdf. Consolidation last edited 15 July 2026.
notes: Chosen over חוק החשמל. The candidate list offered either or both; I fetched חוק החשמל, תשי״ד–1954 (ס״ח תשי״ד, 190, Wikisource page חוק החשמל, last amended 5785, page last edited 30 December 2025) and confirmed from the page itself that it is an occupational-licensing and electrical-installation-safety statute — licensing of electricians, technicians and electrical engineers — with no provisions on tariffs, consumer billing or disconnection. It is therefore the wrong instrument for this topic and is deliberately excluded. Caveat for the encoder: the Electricity Sector Law sets the framework and the Authority's tariff power, but the operative detail of consumer billing, metering, deposits, arrears and disconnection lives in the Electricity Authority's rules (כללי משק החשמל) made under it — subordinate legislation, not statute. An encoding of billing rights from the statute alone will be thin.
